content: ETA smoothing practice from StackOverflow's ETA computation thread: naive remaining=(n-prog)*rate jumps badly near completion; use EWMA/decay-weighted rate so the estimate is stable, and change the displayed value with hysteresis rather than on every sample. NN/G response-time limits (0.1s/1s/10s) justify a determinate number only once the wait is long enough to be noticed; for sub-10s waits a single coarse number is preferable to an animation.
